### Analytics {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/analytics}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then open a campaign; "Analytics" is the default tab.
- KPI cards: "Leads Contacted" = unique leads with at least one email, shown as "x / y leads uploaded", capped at uploads, counts people.
- "Replies": count and reply rate vs leads contacted. "Include auto replies" toggle is on by default (counts out-of-office); off = manual replies only.
- "Positive Replies": AI-classified genuine interest (not out-of-office, not interested, unsubscribes). Rate vs leads contacted; target is Healthy PRR from the "Options" tab (podcast default 1%). Below target, the agent may flag the campaign.
- "Booked Calls": count and rate vs positive replies; target default 25%, set in "Options". Healthy positive replies but few bookings means the reply-to-booking handoff is the problem.
- Trend chart lines: "Contacted" (emails sent per day, including follow-ups, so it differs from the KPI), "Replied", "Positive". Ranges: 7, 14, 30, 90 days, Last year, All time. Replied flattening while Contacted climbs means follow-up fatigue.
- Per-step tables: per-variant "Sent", "Replied", "Positive Responses", "Booked Calls" plus a Total row; all per-email, not per-lead. Each variant has an enable/disable toggle; disabling stops future use, history stays. The agent acts only after a variant passes the "Minimum Threshold" of sends.
- Zero replies after 1,000+ sends: check bounce rate on the Leads tab (auto-pause at 5%), inbox health in Email Accounts (below 80% is a problem), domain errors, and send yourself a test.
- No chart activity 3+ days: check campaign status, sending schedule in "Options", inbox health, "Attention Needed" banners.

### Sequences {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/sequences}

- "Add Variant": use 2 to 3 per step. Variants don't auto-save, so click "Save" before switching.
- Disable variants rather than delete (delete wipes analytics). The agent can disable variants if "Optimize email variants" is "Run automatically"; "Ask first" requests approval.
- Variables, case-sensitive, inserted via the `{ }` Variables button: `{{firstName}}`, `{{lastName}}`, `{{companyName}}`, `{{industry}}`, `{{jobTitle}}`. - "Preview" shows placeholders, not real lead data.
- Links: paste plain URLs; none in Step 1; one per follow-up.
- Edits apply to future sends only.
- Raw `{{firstName}}` in emails: field blank or typo. "Unknown variables detected": replace via Variables button.
- Generic AI draft: sharpen the audience in Options, then duplicate the campaign (three-dots menu on the Campaigns list). No in-place regeneration.

### Inbox warmup {slug: cold-email-agent/email-accounts/warmup}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then "Email Accounts"
- Warmup runs automatically on every inbox. Initial warmup: orange flame, new DFY inboxes, about 2 weeks, cannot send campaigns until green. Continuous warmup: green flame, ongoing. Pre-warmed inboxes skip initial warmup and are green on day one.
- Health score: 90%+ good. 80-90% warning (keep warmup, add no volume, watch reply rate with auto-replies). Below 80% pause from campaigns; replacing is usually safer. Dash = not enough data. It reflects warmup traffic only.
- Ready when "Status" is "Active", flame green, score 90%+ (or dash with green flame).
- Score dropped: causes are bounces over 5%, too much volume (platform cap 30 campaign emails per inbox per day), spammy copy. Pause from campaigns, keep warmup on, recheck in 5-7 days.
- Orange after 2 weeks: Error, use "Reconnect"; Paused, re-enable; Warmup, wait 3-5 days; over 3 weeks, contact support.
- 0 emails and no score: still provisioning (wait 24 hours), Paused, or Error.
- High score but no replies: check bounce rate in Analytics, copy, angle.

### Compliance {slug: cold-email-agent/concepts/compliance}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "AI SDR Inbox"; or "Settings" > "Cold Email Blocklist"
- CAN-SPAM (US): identify sender, physical address (PO Box fine), working unsubscribe honoured within 10 business days, no deceptive subject. No opt-in needed.
- GDPR (EU/UK): lawful basis (B2B usually legitimate interest), honour unsubscribes immediately, answer data requests (about 30 days). Purchased lists very risky.
- CASL (Canada): express or implied consent.
- Platform: AI SDR detects opt-out replies. "Add to DNC" in AI SDR Inbox or "Cold Email Blocklist". Unsubscribe events move the lead to Unsubscribed and block it. Hard bounces blocked; high bounce rates pause the campaign. SPF, DKIM, DMARC auto-set on platform-bought domains.
- You handle: address and opt-out wording, lawful basis, list sources, copy (not reviewed). Data requests: search the Leads tab, remove the lead.
- Keep bounce rate under 3%. Legal threat: stop, add to DNC, document, consult counsel. Procurement documents: contact support.
